description: This file contains SQL scripts for creating tables, stored procedures, and queries related to an Orleans streaming system, including message sequencing, message storage, dead letter handling, and eviction logic.

methods.name: QueueStreamMessage
methods.description: Stores a new message into the Orleans stream message table with a generated message ID and sets visibility and expiration times.

methods.name: GetStreamMessages
methods.description: Retrieves and locks a batch of messages for processing, updating their visibility and dequeue count.

methods.name: ConfirmStreamMessages
methods.description: Confirms and deletes a batch of processed messages based on provided message identifiers.

methods.name: FailStreamMessage
methods.description: Handles message failure by either resetting visibility for retry or moving the message to dead letter storage.

methods.name: EvictStreamMessages
methods.description: Evicts messages that have exceeded attempt limits or expiration, moving them to dead letter storage.

methods.name: EvictStreamDeadLetters
methods.description: Removes dead letter messages that are scheduled for removal.
